items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 14 June 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near Iceland extending a ridge across much of the British Isles.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, becoming east or southeast 4 or 5 overnight, decreasing 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, occasionally moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast, veering south or southwest overnight into Tuesday, 2 to 4, increasing 5 in central areas later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with areas of mist and isolated fog patches developing later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and very poor in fog patches.
